Ruling on the fork the card poses: **honour the override** (`maxLength: override.maxLength ?? def.maxLength`). This is a declared≠enforced restoration, not a feature: the docstring promises overrides win, every sibling key implements it, and #5542 deliberately made the key writable by converging onto the shared declaration — an object-only carve-out would be narrowing a declared authoring surface, which would need a ruling this card gives no business case for (a tighter per-form ceiling over a generous object ceiling is a legitimate authoring intent; note the override can only matter within the object's storage ceiling at submit time regardless). Dispatch note: the #5542 pin `expect(row.maxLength).toBeUndefined()` records the OLD answer — its flip to the override value is the pre-registered evidence of the fix, not collateral damage; delete-or-invert, do not green it around. Same file as #5594 — **fold-or-serial answer: serial** (different functions but one hot file and #5594 carries its own pin work; two S diffs, cheap to sequence, folding fails five-gate ① different defect shape/fix).
